objects.name: agency
objects.description: An entry in one of an agency's own catalogues: a service, a class, a tender, whatever that catalogue lists.

objects.name: agency_private
objects.description: What the operator knows about an agency and no storefront reader may see.

objects.name: share_link
objects.description: One key that opens a private agency. An agency may have many, so a rotation can overlap.

objects.name: suggestion
objects.description: A proposal that some archetype is worth mining, filed cheaply and waiting on a person before anything is built.

objects.name: suggestion_comment
objects.description: One note on a proposal: a run saying what is left after a failed build, or a person saying why they decided as they did.

objects.name: suggestion_match
objects.description: Records that one agency answers one proposal.

objects.name: mining_run
objects.description: One run of the routine that fills the catalog, and its own report of what it did.

objects.name: setting
objects.description: One run-time knob the routine reads, such as the rule it ranks the catalog by. A key/value store because knobs are added faster than a schema should change.

objects.name: page_view
objects.description: A running count for one storefront page.

objects.name: form_record
objects.description: One member's latest answers to one form, as sent.

objects.name: me_too
objects.description: A member saying "me too" to an item on the public board.

objects.name: raised_item
objects.description: An idea, report or complaint a resident raised, or a clerk filed on their behalf.

objects.name: board_item
objects.description: An item on the public board, grouping what residents raised about the same thing.

objects.name: reply
objects.description: An answer to something a resident raised.

objects.name: scope_figure
objects.description: A dated, sourced estimate of how many people live in a ward, the denominator a coverage count is read against.

objects.name: removal
objects.description: Something a resident raised that was taken off the board, and why.

objects.name: raised_item_file
objects.description: A photo or file a resident attached to something they raised.
